# Fast-Devs Project

> Fast-Devs Project is the brand of Marco Ricca, an independent Italian developer of native apps for the Apple ecosystem: iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac. Active since 2010, with a privacy-first approach.

The site is bilingual: Italian by default, English through the language switch. Page content is rendered client-side from JSON files, so the JSON links below hold the full copy in both languages (fields ending in `_en` are the English text). For support, questions or bug reports, use the contact form on the home page.

## Home

- [Fast-Devs Project](https://fastdevsproject.com/): home page with the full app catalogue, blog and contact form
- [Apps catalogue](https://fastdevsproject.com/data/apps.json): every app, current and past, with description, platforms, App Store link and availability (`"removed"` marks apps no longer on the App Store)
- [Blog](https://fastdevsproject.com/data/blog.json): news posts about the apps and the developer
- [App Store developer page](https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/fast-devs-project/id380985711): all published apps

## Device Monitor²

- [Landing page](https://fastdevsproject.com/device-monitor/): free, privacy-first app for monitoring RAM, CPU, GPU, battery, network, storage and sensors in real time on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac, with no data collection
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/device-monitor/id1522870046): download page
- [Features](https://fastdevsproject.com/device-monitor/data/features.json): main features
- [Kits](https://fastdevsproject.com/device-monitor/data/kits.json): optional in-app Kits, one-time purchases with no subscriptions; features can differ by platform
- [Compatibility](https://fastdevsproject.com/device-monitor/data/compatibility.json): supported devices and minimum OS versions
- [Changelog](https://fastdevsproject.com/device-monitor/data/changelog.json): release history, newest first; entries are split by `platform` (`ios`, `macos`) and the first entry of each platform is the current version

## iWindRose²

- [Landing page](https://fastdevsproject.com/iwindrose/): app for sea enthusiasts on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, with wind rose, weather forecasts, marine bulletins, tides, scales and more
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/iwindrose/id1403142267): download page
- [Features](https://fastdevsproject.com/iwindrose/data/features.json): main features
- [Compatibility](https://fastdevsproject.com/iwindrose/data/compatibility.json): supported devices and minimum OS versions
- [Changelog](https://fastdevsproject.com/iwindrose/data/changelog.json): release history, newest first; the first entry is the current version

## Optional

- [Device Monitor² press](https://fastdevsproject.com/device-monitor/data/press.json): articles and videos about the app
- [iWindRose² press](https://fastdevsproject.com/iwindrose/data/press.json): articles and videos about the app
- [Televideo² Pro](https://fastdevsproject.com/televideo-pro/): archived landing page of the app for reading RAI Televideo (Italian teletext) news on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV; it was removed from the App Store in 2021 at the request of FAPAV, acting on behalf of RAI, and is no longer available
- [Televideo² Pro changelog](https://fastdevsproject.com/televideo-pro/data/changelog.json): full release history for iOS and tvOS
